title: Lemo Clip
description: A single authored lemo motion-graphics clip: the clip's identity and idea, its delivery format, the authoring workspace with its three files (clip.json, clip.js, index.html), the resolved inputs, and the per-clip QA verdict. Additional project-specific fields are allowed.

clip_id.description: Stable identifier for this clip within the production, e.g. 'clip-01'.

style_id.description: The lemo style this clip is authored in, e.g. 'swiss-motion'.

one_idea.description: The single idea the clip must make legible.

sound.description: Sound design for the clip, e.g. 'none' or 'foley'.

text_mode.description: How on-screen text is used, e.g. 'title' or 'none'.

workspace.description: Directory holding the clip's authored files.

index_html.description: Path to the clip's index.html entry point.

inputs.description: Resolved inputs consumed by the clip (supplied assets such as screenshots or footage); empty when the clip is fully procedural.

validate_ok.description: True when the clip passed schema and render validation.
